label: HART (wired)

bitrate_bps.label: Bitrate

bitrate_bps.source_revision: TI SLAAEH0 November2023 sections1.1-1.5 pp2-9; FieldComm character-time support article modified2016-11-11; full licensed HART specifications not read

payload_bytes.label: Payload
payload_bytes.description: Actual encoded HART data excl response status; count/whole frame differ, no8-byte default.
payload_bytes.source_revision: TI SLAAEH0 November2023 sections1.1-1.5 pp2-9; FieldComm character-time support article modified2016-11-11; full licensed HART specifications not read

target_bus_load_percent.label: Ziel-Buslast
target_bus_load_percent.description: Zielwert fuer die aus Routing, Payload, Zyklus und Bitrate berechnete Buslast.

hart_profile.label: profile
hart_profile.description: Actual selected implementation/revision scope. Public FSK rules do not certify C8PSK, WirelessHART or HART-IP.
hart_profile.source_revision: TI SLAAEH0 November2023 sections1.1-1.5 pp2-9; FieldComm character-time support article modified2016-11-11; full licensed HART specifications not read

hart_phy.label: phy
hart_phy.description: Actual wired modulation. FSK standard baseline1200bit/s; C8PSK9600bit/s is a different mode requiring actual matched modem. HART-IP/WirelessHART need separate transport paths.
hart_phy.source_revision: TI SLAAEH0 November2023 sections1.1-1.5 pp2-9; FieldComm character-time support article modified2016-11-11; full licensed HART specifications not read

hart_revision.label: revision
hart_revision.description: Actual peer universal-command revision, unknown. Polling range and command capability must match it; not automatically latest7.
hart_revision.source_revision: TI SLAAEH0 November2023 sections1.1-1.5 pp2-9; FieldComm character-time support article modified2016-11-11; full licensed HART specifications not read

hart_role.label: role
hart_role.description: Actual sending endpoint role, unknown. Requests originate at host; response/burst at field device.
hart_role.source_revision: TI SLAAEH0 November2023 sections1.1-1.5 pp2-9; FieldComm character-time support article modified2016-11-11; full licensed HART specifications not read

hart_host_role.label: host role
hart_host_role.description: Actual interacting host identity, unknown. Primary/secondary arbitration and quiet times differ; not universal primary master.
hart_host_role.source_revision: TI SLAAEH0 November2023 sections1.1-1.5 pp2-9; FieldComm character-time support article modified2016-11-11; full licensed HART specifications not read

hart_binding_source.label: binding source
hart_binding_source.description: Required actual registered modem/port/current-loop binding and both endpoint capabilities, unknown.
hart_binding_source.source_revision: TI SLAAEH0 November2023 sections1.1-1.5 pp2-9; FieldComm character-time support article modified2016-11-11; full licensed HART specifications not read

hart_device_source.label: device source
hart_device_source.description: Required actual device description/revision/commands/preamble and response behavior, unknown.
hart_device_source.source_revision: TI SLAAEH0 November2023 sections1.1-1.5 pp2-9; FieldComm character-time support article modified2016-11-11; full licensed HART specifications not read

hart_physical_source.label: physical source
hart_physical_source.description: Required actual impedance/cable/power/coupling/modem/IS/filtering evidence, unknown; nominal FSK rate does not prove installation.
hart_physical_source.source_revision: TI SLAAEH0 November2023 sections1.1-1.5 pp2-9; FieldComm character-time support article modified2016-11-11; full licensed HART specifications not read

hart_schedule_source.label: schedule source
hart_schedule_source.description: Required actual host arbitration, command turnaround, retry/burst and complete transaction schedule evidence, unknown.
hart_schedule_source.source_revision: TI SLAAEH0 November2023 sections1.1-1.5 pp2-9; FieldComm character-time support article modified2016-11-11; full licensed HART specifications not read

hart_mode.label: mode
hart_mode.description: Actual request/response or device-supported enabled burst mode, unknown. Generic multicast is not wired HART burst.
hart_mode.source_revision: TI SLAAEH0 November2023 sections1.1-1.5 pp2-9; FieldComm character-time support article modified2016-11-11; full licensed HART specifications not read

hart_frame_kind.label: frame kind
hart_frame_kind.description: Actual frame direction/category; status and delimiter differ between request and field response/burst.
hart_frame_kind.source_revision: TI SLAAEH0 November2023 sections1.1-1.5 pp2-9; FieldComm character-time support article modified2016-11-11; full licensed HART specifications not read

hart_address_format.label: address format
hart_address_format.description: Actual encoded short1-byte or long5-byte address; long unique identity is distinct from polling number.
hart_address_format.source_revision: TI SLAAEH0 November2023 sections1.1-1.5 pp2-9; FieldComm character-time support article modified2016-11-11; full licensed HART specifications not read

hart_address_bytes.label: address bytes
hart_address_bytes.description: Actual address field octets: short1, long5. No arbitrary2/3/4-byte encoding.
hart_address_bytes.source_revision: TI SLAAEH0 November2023 sections1.1-1.5 pp2-9; FieldComm character-time support article modified2016-11-11; full licensed HART specifications not read

hart_poll_address.label: poll address
hart_poll_address.description: Actual device polling number, unknown: rev5-or-earlier0..15, rev6+0..63. Point-to-point0 is a proposal, not a real device assignment.
hart_poll_address.source_revision: TI SLAAEH0 November2023 sections1.1-1.5 pp2-9; FieldComm character-time support article modified2016-11-11; full licensed HART specifications not read

hart_topology.label: topology
hart_topology.description: Actual current-loop topology, unknown. Multidrop analog fixed-current behavior requires actual revision/device configuration.
hart_topology.source_revision: TI SLAAEH0 November2023 sections1.1-1.5 pp2-9; FieldComm character-time support article modified2016-11-11; full licensed HART specifications not read

hart_expanded_device_type.label: expanded device type
hart_expanded_device_type.description: Actual14-bit expanded device type in qualified long-address layout, unknown; not an automatically generated device identifier.
hart_expanded_device_type.source_revision: TI SLAAEH0 November2023 sections1.1-1.5 pp2-9; FieldComm character-time support article modified2016-11-11; full licensed HART specifications not read

hart_device_id.label: device id
hart_device_id.description: Actual24-bit device ID in qualified long-address layout, unknown; host and burst flags are separate.
hart_device_id.source_revision: TI SLAAEH0 November2023 sections1.1-1.5 pp2-9; FieldComm character-time support article modified2016-11-11; full licensed HART specifications not read

hart_preamble_bytes.label: preamble bytes
hart_preamble_bytes.description: Actual transmitted0xFF preamble octets in public FSK profile. Peer-specific required length and detection loss matter;5 is not a safe default for every unknown peer.
hart_preamble_bytes.source_revision: TI SLAAEH0 November2023 sections1.1-1.5 pp2-9; FieldComm character-time support article modified2016-11-11; full licensed HART specifications not read

hart_peer_preamble_bytes.label: peer preamble bytes
hart_peer_preamble_bytes.description: Actual required preamble length learned from matching field device, unknown. Configured transmit preamble must be at least this.
hart_peer_preamble_bytes.source_revision: TI SLAAEH0 November2023 sections1.1-1.5 pp2-9; FieldComm character-time support article modified2016-11-11; full licensed HART specifications not read

hart_delimiter.label: delimiter
hart_delimiter.description: Actual delimiter octet; qualified FSK encodes address length, expansion count and frame category. C8PSK delimiter rules not inferred from asynchronous FSK.
hart_delimiter.source_revision: TI SLAAEH0 November2023 sections1.1-1.5 pp2-9; FieldComm character-time support article modified2016-11-11; full licensed HART specifications not read

hart_expansion_bytes.label: expansion bytes
hart_expansion_bytes.description: Actual encoded expansion bytes matching delimiter. Normal0 proposal belongs to qualified public FSK layout; future extensions need revision evidence.
hart_expansion_bytes.source_revision: TI SLAAEH0 November2023 sections1.1-1.5 pp2-9; FieldComm character-time support article modified2016-11-11; full licensed HART specifications not read

hart_command.label: command
hart_command.description: Actual wire command octet, unknown. Command31 carries extended16-bit command in data; command support and response semantics remain device-specific.
hart_command.source_revision: TI SLAAEH0 November2023 sections1.1-1.5 pp2-9; FieldComm character-time support article modified2016-11-11; full licensed HART specifications not read

hart_extended_command.label: extended command
hart_extended_command.description: Actual16-bit extended command when wire command31, unknown; its two bytes must be included in transmitted data length, not extra hidden overhead.
hart_extended_command.source_revision: TI SLAAEH0 November2023 sections1.1-1.5 pp2-9; FieldComm character-time support article modified2016-11-11; full licensed HART specifications not read

hart_command_source.label: command source
hart_command_source.description: Actual supported command, request/response data layout, units and encoding source, unknown. Generic data length does not prove functional command compatibility.
hart_command_source.source_revision: TI SLAAEH0 November2023 sections1.1-1.5 pp2-9; FieldComm character-time support article modified2016-11-11; full licensed HART specifications not read

hart_status_bytes.label: status bytes
hart_status_bytes.description: Actual status length: request0, field response/burst2 in qualified FSK layout.
hart_status_bytes.source_revision: TI SLAAEH0 November2023 sections1.1-1.5 pp2-9; FieldComm character-time support article modified2016-11-11; full licensed HART specifications not read

hart_data_bytes.label: data bytes
hart_data_bytes.description: Actual encoded data octets excluding response status, including extended-command bytes when present. Request/response layouts differ; no8-byte default.
hart_data_bytes.source_revision: TI SLAAEH0 November2023 sections1.1-1.5 pp2-9; FieldComm character-time support article modified2016-11-11; full licensed HART specifications not read

hart_byte_count.label: byte count
hart_byte_count.description: Actual byte-count field = data plus status octets, excluding checksum. Response data at most253 when status2; not a universal complete255-byte frame limit.
hart_byte_count.source_revision: TI SLAAEH0 November2023 sections1.1-1.5 pp2-9; FieldComm character-time support article modified2016-11-11; full licensed HART specifications not read

hart_checksum_bytes.label: checksum bytes
hart_checksum_bytes.description: One transmitted XOR checksum octet in qualified public FSK layout; checksum covers delimiter through data, excluding preamble. Numeric length is not executed integrity evidence.
hart_checksum_bytes.source_revision: TI SLAAEH0 November2023 sections1.1-1.5 pp2-9; FieldComm character-time support article modified2016-11-11; full licensed HART specifications not read

hart_checksum_source.label: checksum source
hart_checksum_source.description: Actual XOR calculation and observed parity/byte stream evidence, unknown; no auto-confirmed checksum or authentication.
hart_checksum_source.source_revision: TI SLAAEH0 November2023 sections1.1-1.5 pp2-9; FieldComm character-time support article modified2016-11-11; full licensed HART specifications not read

hart_wire_octets.label: wire octets
hart_wire_octets.description: Actual whole frame incl preamble/delimiter/address/expansion/command/count/status/data/checksum. Separate from data and byte count.
hart_wire_octets.source_revision: TI SLAAEH0 November2023 sections1.1-1.5 pp2-9; FieldComm character-time support article modified2016-11-11; full licensed HART specifications not read

hart_char_bits.label: char bits
hart_char_bits.description: FSK asynchronous character:1start+8dataLSB-first+odd parity+1stop=11bits. These bounds apply only to selected qualified FSK profile; not generic8N1.
hart_char_bits.source_revision: TI SLAAEH0 November2023 sections1.1-1.5 pp2-9; FieldComm character-time support article modified2016-11-11; full licensed HART specifications not read

hart_wire_bits.label: wire bits
hart_wire_bits.description: Actual serialization bits including all qualified FSK characters, not payload×8. C8PSK encoded stream needs actual physical evidence.
hart_wire_bits.source_revision: TI SLAAEH0 November2023 sections1.1-1.5 pp2-9; FieldComm character-time support article modified2016-11-11; full licensed HART specifications not read

hart_serialization_ms.label: serialization ms
hart_serialization_ms.description: Actual frame serialization time from complete encoded bits and selected physical rate, excluding turnaround/gaps/arbitration; not whole transaction latency.
hart_serialization_ms.source_revision: TI SLAAEH0 November2023 sections1.1-1.5 pp2-9; FieldComm character-time support article modified2016-11-11; full licensed HART specifications not read

hart_gap_us.label: gap us
hart_gap_us.description: Actual worst inter-character gap; qualified FCG FSK rule requires less than one11-bit character time. No universal gap0 default.
hart_gap_us.source_revision: TI SLAAEH0 November2023 sections1.1-1.5 pp2-9; FieldComm character-time support article modified2016-11-11; full licensed HART specifications not read

hart_slave_timeout_chars.label: slave timeout chars
hart_slave_timeout_chars.description: Qualified FieldComm2016 FSK slave timeout28character times; timeout is not actual device processing latency or application deadline.

hart_hold_chars.label: hold chars
hart_hold_chars.description: Qualified FieldComm2016 FSK HOLD2character times, separate from frame serialization and actual modem turnaround.

hart_link_grant_chars.label: link grant chars
hart_link_grant_chars.description: Qualified FieldComm2016 FSK link grant RT2=8character times.

hart_quiet_chars.label: quiet chars
hart_quiet_chars.description: Qualified FieldComm2016 FSK RT1 primary33/secondary41character times. Master identity must be explicit.

hart_response_start_ms.label: response start ms
hart_response_start_ms.description: Actual request-end to response-start upper bound incl device and modem, unknown; qualified FCG timeout relation applies. Does not include response duration.
hart_response_start_ms.source_revision: TI SLAAEH0 November2023 sections1.1-1.5 pp2-9; FieldComm character-time support article modified2016-11-11; full licensed HART specifications not read

hart_retry_limit.label: retry limit
hart_retry_limit.description: Actual host/device retry budget, unknown; no inherited CAN0 or Siemens client-specific universal value.
hart_retry_limit.source_revision: TI SLAAEH0 November2023 sections1.1-1.5 pp2-9; FieldComm character-time support article modified2016-11-11; full licensed HART specifications not read

hart_retry_bound_ms.label: retry bound ms
hart_retry_bound_ms.description: Actual total additional retry/arbitration recovery bound, unknown. Per-message or transport-independent timeout cannot substitute.
hart_retry_bound_ms.source_revision: TI SLAAEH0 November2023 sections1.1-1.5 pp2-9; FieldComm character-time support article modified2016-11-11; full licensed HART specifications not read

hart_burst_supported.label: burst supported
hart_burst_supported.description: Actual endpoint burst capability confirmed by device source, unknown; enabling mode must not fabricate support.
hart_burst_supported.source_revision: TI SLAAEH0 November2023 sections1.1-1.5 pp2-9; FieldComm character-time support article modified2016-11-11; full licensed HART specifications not read

hart_burst_period_ms.label: burst period ms
hart_burst_period_ms.description: Actual device/revision configured burst schedule, unknown. Tutorial3-4updates/s is illustrative, not a universal standard period.
hart_burst_period_ms.source_revision: TI SLAAEH0 November2023 sections1.1-1.5 pp2-9; FieldComm character-time support article modified2016-11-11; full licensed HART specifications not read

hart_loop_load_ohms.label: loop load ohms
hart_loop_load_ohms.description: Actual loop receiver resistor/communication load for qualified TI FSK example230..600Ohm, typically250. Bounds are not universal total loop impedance; device-specific topology requires actual source.
hart_loop_load_ohms.source_revision: TI SLAAEH0 November2023 sections1.1-1.5 pp2-9; FieldComm character-time support article modified2016-11-11; full licensed HART specifications not read

hart_loop_supply_v.label: loop supply v
hart_loop_supply_v.description: Actual loop supply and device compliance budget, unknown; not a universal24V supply.
hart_loop_supply_v.source_revision: TI SLAAEH0 November2023 sections1.1-1.5 pp2-9; FieldComm character-time support article modified2016-11-11; full licensed HART specifications not read

hart_loop_current_ma.label: loop current ma
hart_loop_current_ma.description: Actual operating analog loop current, unknown;4..20mA measurement range and multidrop fixed current are not arbitrary digital defaults.
hart_loop_current_ma.source_revision: TI SLAAEH0 November2023 sections1.1-1.5 pp2-9; FieldComm character-time support article modified2016-11-11; full licensed HART specifications not read

hart_signal_pp_ma.label: signal pp ma
hart_signal_pp_ma.description: Actual FSK signal amplitude at matched load, unknown.1mApp is nominal tutorial value, not measured endpoint evidence.
hart_signal_pp_ma.source_revision: TI SLAAEH0 November2023 sections1.1-1.5 pp2-9; FieldComm character-time support article modified2016-11-11; full licensed HART specifications not read

hart_cable_cap_pf.label: cable cap pf
hart_cable_cap_pf.description: Actual cable/receiver capacitance and length/loading bound, unknown; not I2C400pF or an inferred universal cable length.
hart_cable_cap_pf.source_revision: TI SLAAEH0 November2023 sections1.1-1.5 pp2-9; FieldComm character-time support article modified2016-11-11; full licensed HART specifications not read

hart_is_required.label: is required
hart_is_required.description: Actual hazardous-area/intrinsic-safety requirement, unknown; HART name does not imply certified safe installation.
hart_is_required.source_revision: TI SLAAEH0 November2023 sections1.1-1.5 pp2-9; FieldComm character-time support article modified2016-11-11; full licensed HART specifications not read

hart_is_source.label: is source
hart_is_source.description: Actual matched barriers/entities/cable/loop intrinsically-safe certification evidence, unknown; separate from message checksum.
hart_is_source.source_revision: TI SLAAEH0 November2023 sections1.1-1.5 pp2-9; FieldComm character-time support article modified2016-11-11; full licensed HART specifications not read

parameter_proposals.note: Wired FSK baseline1200bit/s proposal. C8PSK requires explicit actual mode9600 and own codec/PHY evidence. No automatic HART-IP/WirelessHART transport or device identity.

known_limitations: Technology-specific conformance details require a vendor/profile extension.
